name: Arrernte
notes: "Arrernte" is the current preferred academic spelling; "Aranda"/"Arunta" are older colonial-era renderings (Spencer and Gillen, early Strehlow). Orthography is itself a live, documented political/identity issue: Anna Kenny, "Aranda, Arrernte or Arrarnta? The Politics of Orthography and Identity on the Upper Finke River," Oceania 87:3 (2017). Central Australia, Alice Springs/Mparntwe region. Non-state, clan/kinship-based sociopolitical organization; no Polity entity modeled.
